entities.summary: Ellen Hutchins was an early 19th C. Irish botanist. She specialised in seaweeds, lichens, mosses and liverworts. She is known for finding several plants new to science, identifying hundreds of species, and her extensive botanical illustrations in contemporary publications. Her ability to find specimens was admired. She corresponded and exchanged plant specimens with several of the leading UK botanists of her time.
